Vendor / paychex flex cost

Paychex Flex pricing in 2026

Paychex publishes the Essentials price: $39 a month + $5 per employee. Its plan comparison page lists four other plans, Basic, Foundations, Advanced and Complete, states that they start at $65 a month + $8 per employee, and prices each on request. The Essentials page notes that tax administration fees may apply and that W-2s and 1099s cost extra.

How the price is built

Essentials footnotes say additional fees may apply for tax administration and that W-2s and 1099s are available at additional cost. Ask for those as separate lines.

List cost at 100 employees, one year

  • Essentials: $6,468 ($5 x 100 x 12 + $39 x 12)

Before volume discounts, add-ons or any renewal increase. Run your own headcount in the ledger.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

What does Paychex Flex Essentials cost?

$39 a month + $5 per employee, from the Paychex Flex Essentials page (read 24 November 2026). At 10 employees that is $39 + 10 x $5 = $89 a month, before the extra-cost items the page footnotes.

What do the other Paychex plans cost?

Paychex lists Basic, Foundations, Advanced and Complete on its plan comparison page with Plans starting at $65/mo + $8 per employee, and Request Pricing on each plan. Only that starting price is published.

What extra fees should I ask about?

The Essentials page says additional fees may apply for tax administration and that W-2s and 1099s are available at additional cost. Ask for each as a separate line, along with any per-payroll-run charge.

When is Paychex Flex cheaper than Gusto?

On list, Paychex Flex Essentials ($39 + $5 per employee) undercuts Gusto Simple ($49 + $6 per person) at every headcount, by $10 a month plus $1 per employee. Gusto Simple lists more included features, so compare what each plan covers before choosing on price.
